name: deneb-ui-framework-monorepo
description: DENEB UI Framework Monorepo — Created by Chamika Gayashan & Induranga Kawishwara

scripts.build: npm run --workspace=@deneb-ui/core build && npm run --workspace=@deneb-ui/ui build && npm run --workspace=@deneb-ui/create-template sync-template && npm run check:packages
scripts.test: npm run check:lockstep && npm test --workspace=@deneb-ui/core && npm test --workspace=@deneb-ui/cli && npm run smoke:scaffold
scripts.release: npm run bump && npm run publish:all
scripts.release:dry-run: npm run bump && npm run publish:dry-run
